bio: I'm Ahmad Sajid, a software engineer from Okara, now based in Lahore. Game development is what brought me to this field, and I still build with that instinct — software should feel alive on the other side of the screen. These days that means backends, AI agents and automation: systems that hold up in the real world, for real users.

I started freelancing in May 2024, while still at university, building web platforms and automations end to end for clients. My degree ran alongside it — at the University of Agriculture Faisalabad, my final-year project, the UAF Smart E-Library, taught a library catalogue to answer questions through a RAG retrieval layer over pgvector. In 2025 I joined Devisgon, growing from intern to Associate Software Engineer: named project lead on the LaForme booking platform, I led delivery of the Total Store back-office system — live in production today as NEXRA — and supervised university interns as a Site Supervisor.

My flagship personal build is MeMySelfI AI, an agent platform I designed and shipped myself: Docker on AWS EC2, a CI/CD pipeline I set up and managed, and a run in live production. I'm now reading for an MS in Computer Science at the University of Okara alongside my work — and in the background I'm growing into game development, the track I started out wanting.
